title: 'Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun' Season 4's 2nd Main Promo Video Reveals More Cast
content: The staff for the anime of Osamu Nishi 's Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun ( Mairimashita! Iruma-kun ) manga presented the second main promotional video and second main visual for the anime's ongoing fourth season on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Tomb Raider King Animated Series' 2nd Video Unveils Ending Song, More Cast
content: Kadokawa presented the second Japanese-language promotional video for the Korean-animated adaptation of artist 3B2S , storywriter Yuns ( REDICE STUDIO ), original storywriter SAN.G , and character designer P-crush 's Tomb Raider King webtoon on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Junji Ito Omnibus Series Unveils Teaser, Ending Song Artist, Anime Expo Premiere
content: TV Tokyo presented the teaser video, a key visual, and more details for Strange -Itō Junji no Yoru mo Nemurenu Kimyō na Hanashi- (Strange - Junji Ito 's Strange Stories for Sleepless Nights), the live-action omnibus series based on 13 manga stories by Junji Ito , on Saturday.
author: ANN

title: 3 Years Later, One of The Most Stunning Series Confirms an Anime Adaptation
content: The Shojo industry is witnessing a major change in recent years as the demographic keeps announcing new and exciting anime adaptations. For several decades now, most of the mainstream hits have always been battle Shonen, including Dragon Ball, One Piece, Jujutsu Kaisen , and many more.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Mairimashita! Iruma-kun 4th Season' Unveils Additional Cast, Second Promo
content: • The official website of the Mairimashita! Iruma-kun 4th Season ( Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 4 ) television anime unveiled an additional cast, a second key visual (pictured right), and second promotional video on Saturday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Tomb Raider King Anime Reveals New Visual, PV, Additional Cast Ahead of July 8 Premiere
content: The upcoming Tomb Raider King TV anime has revealed its second key visual, PV trailer, and a new cast addition ahead of its July 8 premiere. A new character has also been introduced. Yuko Kaida joins the cast as Keira Clark, a U.S. Army general who oversees relic-related operations. She is featured in the new trailer.
author: Anime Corner

title: Welcome to Demon School, Iruma-kun Season 4 Teases Dem-dol Games in New Main Visual & Trailer
content: Welcome to Demon School! Iruma-kun Season 4 has revealed its second main visual and main PV trailer, introducing additional cast members, and teasing the upcoming Dem-dol Games.
author: Anime Corner

title: Light Novel 'Class de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onnanoko to Tomodachi ni Natta' Concludes With 10th Volume
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for illustrator Azuri Hyuuga announced that Takata 's Class de 2-banme ni Kawaii Onnanoko to Tomodachi ni Natta ( I Became Friends with the Second Cutest Girl in the Class. ) light novel series will end with its tenth volume. The final volume is scheduled to release on July 1.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Casts Active Sumo Wrestlers Tamawashi and Tamashoho in Voice Acting Debut Roles
content: The upcoming historical anime Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia has announced that active professional sumo wrestlers Tamawashi and Tamashoho will join the series’ cast, marking the first voice acting roles of their careers. The anime will premiere with a one-hour special featuring Episodes 1 and 2 on July 4, 2026.
author: Anime Corner

title: Living in a World Without Magic Anime Film Project Expands Overseas With Fan Campaign, Annecy Panel, and Anime Expo 2026 Appearance
content: The feature film adaptation project for Living in a World Without Magic continues to move forward, with new international initiatives announced as the production seeks to expand its global reach and connect directly with anime fans worldwide.
author: Anime Corner
